rule: An alias title is accepted only when every stored row of that title carries the node's mid, and the title is the same entity. A different company or a different work is rejected even if the mid collides. Empty-title mid matches stay on the 2026-10-14 rule.
source: Distinct (Wikipedia title, mid) pairs in data/interim/phase2/gdelt_allowlist/, 163 pairs.
